citations.title: Meal and Entertainment Expenses
citations.quote:
2.1 Meals limits and approvals

Meals expenses in Germany are limited to EUR 40.00 per day.

An itemized receipt is required. Standard approval role: manager. Compare the incurred date against this
document’s effective period. The exception is in section 3.1 on page 3 and must be reviewed together with
this rule.

          Department           Country        Limit (EUR)           Unit                        Approver


         ALL             DE           40.00                per day                  manager
